# Architecture

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/generate_documents.py; edit source records instead. -->


## Canonical documentation projections

### Decision

Four reviewable source record families define the human-facing repository documentation:

| Canonical source | Required status | Generated artifact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.agents/notes/*.md` | `published` | `.agents/README.md` |
| `.agents/requests/*.md` | `approved` | `.agents/PRD.md` |
| `.agents/decisions/*.md` | `accepted` | `.agents/ARCHITECTURE.md` |
| `.agents/rules/*.md` | `active` | `.agents/AGENTS.md` |

Records have status frontmatter and are assembled in filename order with backlinks. The dependency-free generator verifies the derived Markdown in CI. Root README and CONTRIBUTING are Git symlinks to generated `.agents/README.md` and `.agents/AGENTS.md`; there are no independently edited duplicates.

The **distributed product policy** `.agents/bundle/AGENTS.md` is a separate artifact from the **repository maintenance rules** `.agents/AGENTS.md`: these documents have different consumers and must not be conflated. The bundle compiler owns host ZIP generation.

### Rationale

One editorial owner per kind of knowledge prevents stale claims. Keeping product instructions independent avoids leaking repository maintenance or CI-specific rules into downstream users.

### Consequences

Edit records before projections, then run `python3 .github/scripts/generate_documents.py --write` and `--check`. `.agents/TODO.md` and `.agents/PLAN.md` are maintained directly. Unpublished notes do not appear in generated docs.

_Source: [0001-single-document-source.md](decisions/0001-single-document-source.md)_


## Native delivery and immutable releases

### Decision

`development` integrates changes and `main` is the release branch. Only a PR sourced from this repository's `development` may target `main`. The release-promotion workflow attempts to create a GitHub Actions bot-authored PR, allowing an independent human owner review. It **cannot operate** until the repository administrator enables GitHub Actions to create pull requests; a user-authored promotion cannot satisfy its own independent approval. When enabled, the workflow dispatches checks on the `development` head SHA because `GITHUB_TOKEN`-created PRs do not trigger normal `pull_request` workflows. A green check or configuration declaration never substitutes for live GitHub branch protection. All CI workflows live under real `.github/workflows/` paths; the branch policy workflow is supplemental and does not replace live GitHub protection.

The active `repo.versioning.mode` is `tags`: there is no required `VERSION` file. On push to `main`, resolve a SemVer tag already pointing at that commit or compute the next patch release tag. Tags must never move to a different commit. The release job generates five host-specific archives plus checksums from the merged source and publishes them. Existing published asset bytes must match fresh builds on reruns; mismatches are errors, not grounds for overwriting an immutable release.

The release code also supports an explicitly configured `file` version mode requiring a strict `VERSION` file, but the product is distributed in tag-only mode.

### Rationale

Git tags are the sole published version authority and there are no purely mechanical version-bump commits. Reproducible artifacts make release replays auditable.

### Consequences

Verify actual branch protection, PR source, checks, tag SHA, archive hashes and release assets before claiming completion. Failed or partial publication requires repair without moving tags or silently replacing assets.

_Source: [0002-development-and-release.md](decisions/0002-development-and-release.md)_


## One portable agent capability source

### Decision

All distributed host variants compile from the single authored policy `.agents/bundle/AGENTS.md`, a sorted named allowlist `.agents/bundle/bundle.json`, the referenced `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` directories, and role reference Markdown under `.agents/bundle/roles/`. Keep workflow content vendor-neutral; host packaging is compiled and must not become independently maintained.

Repository-specific role profiles and operational guidance remain under `.agents/agents/` and generated `.agents/AGENTS.md`; these govern maintenance of this repository and are **not** silently bundled into consumers. Additional repository-local skills may exist but do not ship without explicit allowlisting.

Compile five host formats: Codex portable `plugin.json`, Claude Code `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, Pi `package.json` with `pi.skills`, DSH native `.agents/skills` root, and generic AGENTS.md-compatible project layout. No host must be configured to use another agent's runtime.

### Rationale

Single ownership avoids copy drift, accidentally duplicated instructions, and accidental publishing of repo-only maintenance skills. Host adapters should only express genuine discovery differences.

### Verification

Static validation demonstrates structural compatibility, not behavioral impact. Require independent host discovery and benchmark results before asserting effectiveness.

_Source: [0003-agent-roles-and-skills.md](decisions/0003-agent-roles-and-skills.md)_


## Repository-local automation is not part of the product bundle

### Decision

`.agents/` and `.github/` are real, independent Git directories. `.agents/` owns project requirements, decisions, published notes, contributor rules, reusable roles, distributed policy and Agent Skills. `.github/` owns native workflow definitions, packaging/release scripts, and all repository tests and fixtures under `.github/tests/`.

`.darkfactory` remains the explicitly pinned root submodule of `marius-patrik/DarkFactory` for repository automation and quality governance. It is not a consumer requirement and is excluded from published Agent Brain ZIPs. Live GitHub workflows remain physically under `.github/workflows/`; a symlink cannot replace GitHub's native workflow tree.

### Consequences

Changes to a local workflow, repo configuration or submodule pin require review and verification. Packaging is owned solely by `.github/scripts/build_bundles.py`. Do not copy tests, credentials, repository metadata, or the submodule into release archives. All tests remain in `.github/tests/`.

_Source: [0004-single-darkfactory-root.md](decisions/0004-single-darkfactory-root.md)_


## Agent Brain repository and package identity

### Decision

The repository is `marius-patrik/agent-brain`. Publish future releases using `agent-brain` as the manifest name and ZIP filename prefix for every supported agent host. Previously published release tags and assets remain immutable; no alias or transitional production implementation is introduced.

Synchronize the actual GitHub repository name with `repo.dfconfig.repo.identity.repo`, the managed DarkFactory installation receipt slug and its source hashes, the compiler package identity, the host installation smoke tests, the README and the release catalog. A repository rename does not implicitly rename an independent GitHub Projects board; the configured board and project title must reflect its real live name, not a guessed rename.

### Consequences

Generated documents change only through canonical source records. A version bump is generated from `main` on release, with a new set of assets. Asset names and package identity must match, while all five host-specific installation contracts remain independently verified.

_Source: [0005-agent-brain-identity.md](decisions/0005-agent-brain-identity.md)_
